reviews.title: An ok experience
reviews.text: In January 2023 flew Madrid-Luxor, Aswan-Cairo and Cairo-Madrid with them. Planes were old, and you realise this when your ears pop much more than in modern aeroplanes. Legroom Ryanair standard. Service was ok to good. Delay on Aswan-Cairo leg of several hours. All our bags arrived safely on all flights. They were charter flights, so there was food and it was actually quite good. So don’t be put off by all the bad reviews. It can be more than ok.
reviews.author: Dewi P

reviews.title: No service, No information
reviews.text: Flere with FlyEgypt From Copenhagen to Sharm and back. We were delayed out of Copenhagen and on the way back via Billund (flown by Nile Air) we got delayed once again. The crew were asked several times and by several passengers to inform us about what was going on. The passengers that got up and asked ad crew member was informed - no information was given to the cabin on the PA system. During the flights the crew were standoffish and seemed that they didn’t want to provide a minimum of service. Never flying Fly Egypt again if at all avoidable
reviews.author: Bjørn W

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: A disgusting flight company, the trip was late for 6 hours without any notice , the smell of the aeroplane was awful , the crew was grumpy Don’t recommend at all
reviews.author: Yasmin S

reviews.title: very very bad . i lost my bag and no reply till now
reviews.text: very bad air line i lost my bag date of 15/05/2023 . and i send more email and no reply . and i call also but no one reply me and i lost many things.
reviews.author: mohamed a

reviews.title: Thought it was just an economy flight, but it's truly less than that
reviews.text: Trip on 27 april 2023 To start with, how is the policy staying 30 kg to fit in 1 bag? Unless I booked extra baggage, I could have either thrown my personal stuff, miss my flight or had to pay what I can't afford. Then to arrive and find my luggage was opened by breaking the zippers??? Is that even legal? No proper service when my child got motion sickness! the reply was (we are landing, it's dangerous now wait till we land) which was another disaster! Who gets in turbulence nearly on the ground??? After nearly landing, the pilot decided to take off again and cruise for a while then land, which took an extra 30 minutes and caused my baby to throw up with no chance of us getting to the bathroom because it's too dangerous? And sitting in this filthy vomit pond is ok? It wasn't ok for that to happen and I still have to fly back with them! 🤦🏾‍♀️ Simply pathetic! Thanks for nothing!
reviews.author: Nora J

reviews.title: WORST BAGGAGE EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: The worst problem solving experience I have ever had in all my years of travel. I'm a passenger who flew with FlyEgypt on the 1st of December 2022 to arrive to Sharjah from Cairo I flew with my mother, my cat and 6 bags but only 5 bags have arrived, we registered a missing baggage claim and to this day we haven't received the back in the UAE. After several calls and many promises of resolving this issue we still didn't get the bag. Someone even sent over a picture of the bag to the Sharjah Baggage claim office from Cairo but didn't actually send it over. And that's when the game of pass the bucket began, from employee to employee and department to department and country office to the next it's been well over 4 months and not a singe reply to my several emails, calls messages and complaints. While I was extremely grateful that the airline allowed for my cat to travel with me in cabin since this horrible customer experience my gratitude has been replaced with extreme frustration. It shouldn't take this long to deliver a bag that's already found. In this bag are irreplaceable identity documentation along with sentimental items.
reviews.author: Azza E

reviews.title: FOR YOUR OWN SAFETY please do not fly this airline
reviews.text: Delayed 2 hours on the way inbound from CDG to Hurghada, Egypt. But this was just the beginning of the nightmare FlyEgypt put us through. On 1 April, I, and a group of 176 French were flying back to CDG. Upon arrival at the airport we're told the aircraft we were meant to use has broken down. After a few minutes the airport staff decide to send us to the aircraft anyway, in hope the plane will be fixed soon. 2 busses, when 3 are needed to take our large group, escort us to the plane. The first bus leaves a group of about 50 on the actual runway as no one can get on the plane, the crew won't let them. These guys stayed in the scorching sun for 1 hour before a bus picked them back up and brought them back to the airport building. The 2 other bus loads end up loaded with guests and the driver refuses to switch on the AC on-board the vehicle. Doors are locked. People start getting claustrophobic, no one communicates with our groups. Eventually we're taken to a separate and isolated gate room in the airport building, secluded form the duty free area. No information, no explanation or prognostic is given regarding boarding a plane again. After one hour we're told an aircraft, dispatched from Scotland, will pick us up around 7pm, it is now 3 pm, most of us haven't had any drinks or food. We arrived at the airport 5 hours before. The airline will eventually provide us with a disgusting sandwich and a small bottle of water (they didn't even think to provide enough water for all guests initially). The first stock of drinks has to be paid for (they found an opportunity to make profit there), the second one, half an hour later, is for free (Hunger Games). Eventually the flight crew end up not being legal to do the flight as they have been on duty for too long. They dispatch a pilot who turns out to not be legal to fly to Europe as he doesn't have the necessary visas. They send another one - another hour is lost -, around 9pm one of the cabin crew left their crew ID in the hotel (because they didn't want to do the flight as they were probably exhausted and informed last minute on their day off they had to work). We get a second round of bad sandwiches at 10:30pm and a bottle of water (a group of us only had access to a pack of oversweetened fruit juices). There's a 3 year old child in our group, he's hungry, tired and does not understand why we are being held in captivity. Although the main point in keeping us in that secluded boarding gate was for us to not have to go through security searches anew, we're told we have to go through x-ray search again. Problem is: that computer and equipment there is never used, the airport staff needs an hour to get the computer to switch on. We end up going through the whole search again and get taken to the new plane. After boarding the plane (it's now past midnight) and starting to taxi out on the runway, we return to stand and receive information from the flight captain the aircraft has a technical issue and they're looking to fix it. All in all we'll stay on that plane for 5 hours, overnight, without food or drinks, until a passenger ends up grabbing a pack of cups and water bottles from the crew to quench the thirst of the other exhausted, thirsty and hungry pax. We end up escorted to different hotels, to stay for about 2,5 hours from the moment we check in, before returning to the airport around 11:30am, to find yet another broken down plane. We ended up leaving that second day around 17:00, after numerous incidents at the airport, including a medical case in a group of elderly passengers. The airport staff were laughing at us and taking selfies with us as we were desperate to go home. Despicable and DANGEROUS airline.
reviews.author: Dylan

reviews.title: never use this airline
reviews.text: After a few hours at the airport, the flight was canceled without giving reasons. the second flight, which was supposed to take place after many hours of waiting, was delayed by two hours - also without giving reasons. You cannot pay by card on board the plane. they don't sell quality food, just sandwiches. This line is complete chaos. I strongly advise against
reviews.author: Piotr A

reviews.title: Miss
reviews.text: I made a reservation to Hurghada and a month later they cancelled the flight !!!! I had to search for another airline for 9 tickets and paid extra 10 k due to short term. In order to get back my money I had to go to their main office. Part of the tickets value was sent through Fawry! Although I paid for all the tickets with Fawry!! Very bad experience. Don't recommend it at all.
reviews.author: Dalia K

reviews.title: Flight delays without even announcements
reviews.text: Please avoid this airline as they have flight delays like “business as usual” .. they don’t even announce delay for 90minutes .. completely unreliable.
reviews.author: Trail829211

reviews.title: Excellent flight and friendly staff
reviews.text: FlyEgypt is an Egyptian airline that offers low-cost and charter flights. We flew with a charter flight from Ljubljana (Slovenia) to Hurghada (Egypt). We were satisfied with the services of this young airline. They are professional, neat and accurate. Cabin staff are extremely friendly, ready to give instructions and help. The seats were comfortable, the catering services during the flight were satisfactory. The airline is based at Cairo International Airport (CAI) and flies to destinations within Egypt, as well as to cities in the Middle East. FlyEgypt's fleet consists entirely of Boeing aircraft. It has more than five aircraft from the Boeing 737 family currently within its fleet. All praise.
reviews.author: Asiyah Noemi K

reviews.title: Avoid if you can. Worse flight experience.
reviews.text: Worse flight experience. Flew from Sharm El Sheikh to Copenhagen, apparently with a stop over in Oslo. Flight was late from the start in Sharm with 1 hour. Landing 2 hours late in CPH. Compensation law starts at more than 3 hours delay, makes it feels like they’re exploiting this. Interior flight condition is as bad as the norm for any vehicle in Sharm. Makes one question the safety being like in the 90s. Not worth your money. Avoid if you can. If not, accept your fate and pray you’ll be on time or for your safety. No free snacks, so bring your own. Cabin crew is friendly and helpful only when you’re happy. Unsure if they have had training with how to handle unsatisfied customers.
reviews.author: Sandi

reviews.title: It gets you to the destination, but that's about it.
reviews.text: Quite dirty planes outside and in the cabin. Little legroom. My personal carry-on backpack was weighted... and had do pay for excess weight (its weight was 8 kg). Would not recommend this airline, if there is another option.
reviews.author: Urban M

reviews.title: unsatisfied job of cabin crew
reviews.text: cabin crew was sleeping during the flight. Only 1 or 2 of them was awake. they took 3 rangs of seats for themselves to lay down and sleep. One of them asked me to change my place and put me ona very bad seat : cold area, no place for legs. Few seconds later I told her that i don't want this place and I want to go back to my place. She answered too late because she gave my place to another person. And she told me that I should be satisfied because I have a seat ! After that, she put on her pyjama and layed down (ocuuping 3 seats) to sleep. very bad cabin crew
reviews.author: Roxana

reviews.title: Horrible customer experience
reviews.text: I’m writing this even before departure. Horrible experience so far: no online check-in, 1h 40 min line at the airport just to pick up the boarding pass, no wifi at the plane (obviously no possibility to watch the champions league final), old airplane (B737-800), very bad crew organization. Chose any other company.
reviews.author: P. Alfonso

reviews.title: Horrible airline
reviews.text: Worst airline in Egypt … don’t ever get think to get ticket by Flyegypt dirty unqualified crew unsafe aircraft
reviews.author: Egyptian E

reviews.title: Horrible, should have license revoked
reviews.text: Took 2 hours to get a boarding pass, didnt even have any checked in luggage. No online check in option, staff underqualified, couldn’t find my booking confirmation, one staff member claimed my ticket was fake, the other told me to contact the travel agency because it could be a fake ticket, even though i showed them confirmation through the flyegypt website. Eventually supervisor came and found my booking and told the staff theres no such thing as fake ticket. Boarding the aircraft was an hour late. Absolutely disgusting experience
reviews.author: Mohamed B

reviews.title: The Worst Airline in Egypt and Africa
reviews.text: Beware everyone this is the worst airline company in all Egypt and Africa, flight delays for hours, late boarding, permanent loss of luggage, bad and unprofessional attitude from the staff, little or no service.
reviews.author: The G

reviews.title: Go to the toilet before you fly lol
reviews.text: The service is non existent... We could buy either a coke or chips. The best part is that we were advised on check in that you have to bring your own toilet paper!! And on a full flight they only let you use one of the two toilets so there is a constant line. The seats are dirty, I had mould in the seat pocket Infront of me. But hey... If you pay hardly anything I guess maybe thats what you should expect.
reviews.author: Leah T

reviews.title: Almost 5 hours without water
reviews.text: Apart from the fact that the flights were late in both directions, there was absolutely NO service on the flight back to Germany. No water for almost 5 hours! This can not be ok! There were toddlers on that plane! They say it's the German Aviation Society (or something similar, can't remember the exact wording) prohibiting it. However, when flying with a different airline from Hurghada just one month before, one could get food and drinks.
reviews.author: milka_tuktuk

reviews.title: Master
reviews.text: We were 4 hours late and nobody told us anything. Crew in airplane were not nice at all. I can not recomend this flying company.
reviews.author: Jan N

reviews.title: FlyEgypt poor experience
reviews.text: No food on a 6,5 hrs flight, we have received only half a liter of water. The distance between seats was 66 cm which is way below the minimum standard. Not to mention a 24 hrs delay in departure.
reviews.author: Robert T

reviews.title: Better than Smartiwings
reviews.text: It is normal charter flight. You will not earn nothng on the board but it is normale on charter flights. I am sure that it is better that smartwings.
reviews.author: Jakub H

reviews.title: Help!! Booking question about my suitcase
reviews.text: Hi all, This is my first time to Egypt from Toronto and I’m having hell of a time figuring out what my baggage fee will be. It is a local flight. I’m getting stressed out!! Please I ask if you are able to bring your luggage I’m sure they have tons of international travellers that have more then a carry on. Thanks in advance
reviews.author: Corinne W

reviews.title: Average low cost airline
reviews.text: After reading the reviews on this site, my expectations for this flight from Zurich to Hurghada were very low. However, the staff proved to be way friendlier and more professional than the reviews led me to believe. They were always attentive to the needs of the passengers and gave everybody water to drink during the flight - something that not all low cost airlines do. Unfortunately, the reviews concerning the cleanliness (or lack thereof) of the plane proved to be true. I did not use my table because it was too dirty and it looked like some kind of yellow material was leaking out of a vent. All in all, they got me safely and on time from A to B for a low price, which is what I paid for. Therefore, I would still suggest this airline to a friend.
reviews.author: Eliana

reviews.title: Easy flight -
reviews.text: After reading the complaints I was very nervous - however, I was surprised, the cabin crew was dressed smartly, there was no entertainment but I did opt (for free) extra legroom, you didn't get many annoying announcements like buying scratch cards for a charity. I purchased a ham roll, for £3 it was just ham on a roll, no marg no nothing. 2 small pringle tubs and 2 coffee was £12! From the reviews I had thought I would be sat next to a caged chicken - it was nothing like that and a pleasant flight, the seats were a little damaged and small tears in the seat pockets
reviews.author: Roscommoner13

reviews.title: No problems whatsoever
reviews.text: You just go to your seat, sit in it, fly to your destination except you have more legroom and are left in peace to read, sleep etc without endless tannoy announcements,duty free,scratch cards etc, trolleys blocking aisle, queues for toilets and vomitous stink of airline food. Also gives some passengers five hours of sobering up. Cabin crew give you a drink of water, are presentable and professional.
reviews.author: Swampcreature

reviews.title: FlyEgypt flight
reviews.text: This is a new flight from Manchester to Hurghada. At moment they only operate on Tuesday but am sure this may well increase next year.No alchohol on board and limited food and soft drinks but this didnt bother us at all when you consider the price of our holiday;we always book a package holiday to Egypt and since the collapse of Thomas Cook,the price of holidays using Tui or Easyjet flights has rocketed!The cabin crew were very good and we had a very pleasant flight so all in all this is a great value for money flight and we will definately be using them again
reviews.author: caroleswain16

reviews.title: Not bad at all
reviews.text: I was dreading this flight as so many of the reviews were bad but I was plesently surprised the staff were immaculately dressed and very polite and helpful and the lack of alcohol was was actually a refreshing change we took of on time and landed a little ahead of schedule all in all a relaxing flight with no stress or drunken idiots
reviews.author: Tracy E

reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.text: After reading the bad reviews we were a little worried we needn't have been the plane was clean and the staff were dressed immaculately and very professional I would definitely use this airline again
reviews.author: Carole B

reviews.title: Amazing flight
reviews.text: I flew with FlyEgypt to hurghada. To say I it a budget airline and was with a package holiday, I cannot find anything to complain about. The staff were amazing Mahmoud Samer, was polite and gave excellent service, nothing was too much trouble and always had a smile. The one thing FlyEgypt need to do is have flight only booking from UK as I would definitely book. Keep up the good work ❤
reviews.author: Donna's Sunshine Holidays

reviews.title: Great flight with lovely crew!
reviews.text: After reading many a negative review about this airline and being somewhat horrified by the comments, naturally I wasn’t at all looking forward to my flights to and from Hurghada We boarded our aircraft on time, we took off on time and received very pleasant service both ways. The service started with a water service, swiftly followed with a service of light snacks, sandwiches and Hot & Cold drinks. Their is no hard sell (a welcome relief) and no alcohol on any of the services. This for me was not a bad thing and as we anticipated this, we took our own miniature bottles on (bought in the terminal) and the crew didn’t appear as though we had broken any rules by doing this etc. (Sorry if we did). I have done this route many many times and have previously experienced flights that are more like a party bus, not at all helped by the crew pushing the sales off booze and then wondering why they have a problems with disruptive passengers. With this crew having minimal presence in the cabin (ie not trying to sell you something every five minutes), matched with no alcohol on board, resulted in most passengers sleeping, reading or watching films on their own devices for the duration of the flight. The aircraft was lovely and clean, (yes a little tired) however everything worked onboard, the toilets well stocked and clean and the flight was comfortable. The crew were absolutely lovely and (despite what others have experienced from previous reviews), were immaculate in presentation and professionalism. Top marks to fly Egypt! 10/10 from me!
reviews.author: Richard Sanderson

reviews.title: Ann
reviews.text: Was very sceptical about this airline but they turned out to be very professional. Smart uniforms. Free water but soft drinks, snacks and rolls to purchase. Couldn’t fault the service.
reviews.author: annemp21

reviews.title: A very nice flight great cabin crew
reviews.text: I don't know what all the fuss is about the cabin crew lovely and friendly.they had beautiful uniforms very polite and helpful,yes no alcohol on board but some passengers still managed to stagger of the flight embarrassing must have cleaned out their duty free this airline stepped in to get British holiday makers to Egypt in light of Thomas Cook going bust People need to remember this is a budget airline .like Ryanair but for me far better if travellers want alcohol on board in flight entertainment and all the extras,then pay the Double airfair to go with a British airline Thank you Flyegypt.
reviews.author: Susan G

reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.text: Having read several really bad reviews we were almost dreading this flight. What a pleasant surprise it turned out to be. The plane was spotless, the crew polite and efficient, it included 20kgs hold luggage and unrestricted cabin bag. We also got emergency exit seats both ways at no extra cost. The only slight criticism would be the inflight catering. It was pretty much just chocolate bars, soft drinks and quite disgusting, overpriced coffee or tea, although free water was available throughout the flight. A simple solution would be to make / buy a sandwich beforehand.
reviews.author: Jerseyman55

reviews.title: Never again!
reviews.text: All went well, till the pilot announced a stop in Ljubljana due to fog in Salzburg... After landing at 6.00, we had to wait in the airplane until 10.00, without any information! Crew was unable to speak decent english. At 10 am we were taken to a boarding hall, where we could buy a terrible coffee. Boarding again at 12.00, we landed in Salzburg with a delay of 6,5 hours. In Salzburg we were told that the airplane wasn't technical on the newest standard to land in foggy weather!!! 2019?? NEVER AGAIN
reviews.author: Francis Nathali... S

reviews.title: Worst airline I have flown with
reviews.text: At the airport you have to ask someone were the check in desk is as they have no name on the check in desks. We were supposed to be seated on the front rows but when we went to the boarding gate we had our seats changed and were split up by 6 rolls away from each other. We we got on the aircraft we went to sit in our seats we were first allocated and we were told that we can not sit there as this were for the crew. We created and was put in the front row other couples had the same problem as us. We found out later as some of the cabin crew got changed from there uniforms and stretched out in the seats and went to sleep, they woke up just before landing and changed back into there uniforms. When we took off our seat belts were not checked as when the safety belt light came on when we hit a bit of turbulence. When the trolley came round with the drinks you were showing a menu it was put in front of you then taken away in a flash, we asked for 1 tea 1 coffee I gave her a £10 note and was asked what is that we only take dollars or Egyptian pounds I said it is sterling she was still unsure I said what about a card payment but no, she went and asked someone and came back and said ok. The cups are small and the milk is powder for your coffee or tea.The galleria is none stop of people in and out the curtain is kept closed so every time people went to the toilet or the cabin crew was having a chit chat the curtain was open then shut and I was right next to it. Saying all this the crew were very helpful and polite. But the airline makes our cheapest airlines look good
reviews.author: reg b

reviews.title: Family holiday
reviews.text: Well we were caught up in the Thomas Cool collapse and found ourselves put on a flyegypt flight. We did our research and found lots of negative comments on here re this airline. I have to say we found them totally the opposite to what we had read. The staff were friendly and welcoming from the start. There was plenty of refreshments offered and the flight was extremely comfortable. Keep up the great work all and we thank you for the flights both home and away as good as Thomas cook all day 👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼
reviews.author: Nick H

reviews.title: There's cheap and then there's Flyegypt
reviews.text: I will never criticise Ryanair again!!!!!. I have flown thousands of miles on both business and pleasure and this airline take the biscuit for cheap and definitely cheerful. The plane was freezing and most of the passengers complained, the plane was then too hot and then cold. The food service was abysmal to say the least. Sit near the front and you stand a chance of purchasing food, sit to the rear and you are out of luck. Take a packed lunch and a flask!!!!! Having waited over an hour for the attendants to travel the length of the plane you can guarantee hot food will be cold and cold food will be hot!!!. Please do not be alarmed if there is a row of seats empty either behind or in front of you as these will soon be used by the cabin crew to sleep on during the flight. I have never seen cabin crew in jeans and what I presume is off white shirts/blouses and track shoes and do not press the button for assistance as some surly staff member will tell you not to press the call system more than one. You may during the 5 hour plus flight see the cabin crew once maybe twice.
reviews.author: phil

reviews.title: Worst flight of my life
reviews.text: Delayed over two hours then no tea coffee or soft drinks half a cup of warm water in over 7 hours Seat belts on plane very warn and fraying seats badly warn Won’t every fly with these again not what you would expect fro a company taking bookings in uk Engine Noise on plane very Loud
reviews.author: Jonathan M

reviews.title: Brilliant experience
reviews.text: So after reading the negative comments on Tripadvisor about this airline company, I was a little bit apprehensive to board this flight to Hurghada. However, I cannot fault the staff or the airline in the slightest. They maintained professionalism throughout the whole journey. Despite some reviews complaining of only receiving one glass of water and no food throughout their flight, the FlyEgypt team provided refreshments multiple times. Although a hot meal was not provided, sandwiches and snacks were available for passengers to purchase. The Aeroplane itself was clean and well maintained. Seats were comfy and there was plenty of leg room. Yes, staff wear jeans with shirts however they were still presented in a smart manner and were all lovely, polite, and chatty to passengers. On our Outbound flight there was a slight delay before boarding but this was due to various reasons at Manchester Airport that was out of the airlines control. Regardless of this, the journey was prompt and takeoff/landing was smooth. For anybody reading the negative reviews about this airline company and are doubting whether to fly with them, please give them a chance and see for yourself that they’re a brilliant team!
reviews.author: Karl

reviews.title: Worst flight of my life!
reviews.text: DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS AIRLINE AT ALL!! I want to start by saying this flight (FT3905) was a repatriation flight due to the collapse of Thomas Cook so some allowances were made prior to this review. We were due to board at 20.45 on the 25th September for a 21.30 departure. We never started boarding until 21.20. Once onboard, I noticed all cabin crew were wearing either jeans or leggings and scruffy trainers and also white shirts that didn't match each other. Some shirts were untucked and creased!! We never recieved an announcement as to when we were departing until we reached the runway, no water was handed out, seats were falling apart, aircon blowers above seats were hanging out and the plane creaked and groaned with every little bump!! I will 100% guarantee that I will not be stepping on a Fly Egypt flight ever again!!
reviews.author: Jaimie M

reviews.title: Wouldn’t recommend it!
reviews.text: We paid for a direct flight and got a connected flight through Vienna where we couldn’t leave the plane for about an hour. What should have been a 4 hours flight turned into a 6 hours flight. The staff weren’t very friendly but they did help the passengers with their needs. On the way to Sharm El-Sheik they served us food and water but on the return flight we got only water.
reviews.author: Follow me around the World

reviews.title: Very nice trip
reviews.text: Special thanks to Mr wael while boarding ,he is really polite and welcoming person. Also I enjoyed my flight ,professional takeoff and landing from the pilot ,also during the journey we felt very safe and comfortable. The crew was smiling and polite also the plane isn't old and clean
reviews.author: Khalid T

reviews.title: Very good price, kind personell, However, no food and the purchasable food sucks
reviews.text: Very good price, kind flight crew, However, no food on 5 hour flight and the purchasable food sucks. Safe take off and down, however, the flight crew did not follow any of the very basic safety assurances (windows, seats up when landing and take off, etc.), which made me feel unsafe although I am very used to traveling by plane.
reviews.author: Nicolaj Hartmann

reviews.title: Good for a cheap flight
reviews.text: If to compare with other charter flight this was excellent. We got water and not eatable snack but the crew was just fine.
reviews.author: USSlovak

reviews.title: good  economy airlines
reviews.text: service against value is good , team on board are nice and friendly , meal is good but not perfect , at the end we are talking about economy flight airlines , but compare to the others , they are better
reviews.author: ehab n

reviews.title: Perfect flight and very nice stuff
reviews.text: I flew from Graz to Hurghada by the end of May. It was a very smooth flight with nice and very helpful flight attendants. They offered water for free, for food you had to pay (if you really need to eat on a 3,5 hours flight). There is no in-flight entertainment. The plane was spotlessly clean and enough legroom (if I compare this to Condor: it was a luxury flight). We were departing and arriving on time, with no problems at check in. For a charter flight it was really very good. But my suitcase was lost and I ended in a luxury hotel for 14 days without anything. Imagine!! Making a protocol of lost luggage at the airport of Hurghada was easy; searching for my lost suitcase was not. But there is something I have to say; every other day I’ve got an email from FlyEgypt headquarters in Cairo, ensuring me that they are searching for suitcase and they will not give up until they find it. It was a nice feeling knowing that they really care about the situation. After 9 days my suitcase was found at the Graz airport (they have send it to Palermo, after that to Istanbul and finally it came from Munich to Graz. Hurray!). Although I found out that it was a gross negligence of the Graz airport, I wrote a letter to FlyEgypt and according to Montreal convention they ask me to wrote a complain and send it together with my bills to Cairo. After a week they grant it and after 3 weeks (exactly as they promise!) I’ve got my reimburse money at my account. I sure wish European companies would manage complains so easy and stresses. Would I fly with FlyEgypt again? Yes! Any time!! With pleasure :-)
reviews.author: Patricija J

reviews.title: Average, could improve service
reviews.text: The plane itself was not too old, was completely clean (saw someone on here complain about hygiene, didn’t notice anything out of order in that matter). The flight itself felt completely safe. On my outbound flight - we got a glass of water initially, the people who’d ordered food got that. After that - nothing. No menu, no offers what so ever. Several flight attendants just chilling and doing nothing in the front galley. 5 hour flight. Their biggest concern seemed to be keeping the curtain between them and the passengers closed at all times. Also, for some reason they reserve the first seat rows on the plane for crew traveling - even though the rest of the seat rows were completely full. Like one crew member would get 3 sears by him/herself. On my inbound flight - 7 days later - the service level had improved. This time they went around with the trolley and menus. I thought the crew were even friendlier than before. Thumbs up. All in all - would take again - just be prepared for a potential sub standard service!
reviews.author: Andreas

reviews.title: Quiet flight without waiting
reviews.text: Quiet flight without waiting. I can recommend, because airport Piešťany is only for charter flights to Hurghada. No many people, no stress before check in.
